landing.title: Find your brain’s {weak} and train it 10 minutes a day
landing.illoLabel: An ability profile with a highlighted weak spot turns into a 10-minute daily plan
landing.note: No sign-up · no payment · concept by CC-146

teaser.title: Your weak spot: {ability}
teaser.startTitle: This is the start, not the end
teaser.startBody: We’ve built a 4-week plan around your weak spot: {ability}.

paywall.title: Your personal 4-week training plan
paywall.focus: 2 of 3 daily exercises target your weak spot ({ability})
paywall.retest: Re-test on day 30 to see what has changed
paywall.timelineLabel: {ability} now: {score}. Day 30: measured by the re-test.
paywall.timelineNote: We don’t promise a number — on day 30 the re-test measures your real change.

onboarding.title: Your first exercise — right now, 3 minutes
onboarding.sub: Start while your result is fresh.

stroop.name: Color & word
stroop.howto: Tap the ink color of the word, not what the word says.

corsi.name: Flash order
corsi.howto: Tap the squares in the order they lit up. Each correct answer makes the next sequence longer.

series.name: Number series
series.howto: Find the rule and pick the next number.

gonogo.name: Quick reaction
gonogo.howto: Green circle — tap right away. Red circle — don’t tap.
gonogo.stage: Reaction area: tap when the green circle appears

flash41.name: FlashGrid #41
flash41.howto: Repeat the flash sequence. 2 correct in a row — level up; a mistake — level down (Lv 2–9).

today.title: Today’s plan · 10 min
today.allDone: All done for today. See you tomorrow!
today.weakHint: {n} of {total} exercises train your weak spot: {ability}.
today.retestText: A new parallel form shows what has really changed.

index.name: Wittio Index
index.scale: Your training progress on a 0–1000 scale
index.explain: The Index grows when you train regularly and perform well. Skipped days slow it down.

line.title: A reminder that brings you back
line.mockNote: Demo of a LINE notification — nothing is sent.
line.bodyStreak: Time for today’s 10-minute training. Keep your {n}-day streak going!
line.caption: Reminders arrive at the time you choose via LINE, the messenger most people use in Japan. This is a mock: no messages are sent and no data is collected.

retest.title: Re-test every 30 days
retest.intro: Every 30 days you take the test again on a new parallel form (B), so you see real change — not remembered answers.
retest.baselineCaption: Your first test (form A). Your weak spot is highlighted.
retest.simulate: Demo: we simulate {n} days of 10-minute training. Then your abilities are measured for real on form B.
retest.dueNote: 30 days have passed. Take the 60-second re-test on form B.
retest.resultKicker: Form B vs your first test (form A)
retest.honest: These are your real form-B results — scores can also go down.
retest.whyBack: Seeing real change is why people come back.
retest.next: Next re-test in {n} days. Your plan now focuses on your new weak spot: {ability}.

report.title: Weekly report
report.simulated: Includes simulated demo days (about 10 min a day).
report.valueText: {price} per 4 weeks after a {trial} trial: {n} daily sessions, a weekly report and a re-test.

profile.title: Your ability profile
profile.resetNote: Clears all progress on this device and returns to the start.
